about: Israel murmurs again, claiming a share in the priesthood. Moses lets them try: seventy censers are made and carried into the Holy of Holies, and fire consumes the offerers. God has the censers hallowed (read as Mary, Christ and his fragrance), the earth swallows Dathan, Abiram and their households, and a plague takes their followers. Moses and Aaron make atonement, and God commands the writing of the rods that will show Aaron's (Numbers 16-17).

sentences.n: Chapter heading. ኀበ at the head of a title-like clause is rendered 'how' in the published parts (ኀበ አስሐተቶ ለሰሎሞን 'how ... led Solomon astray'); its plain sense is 'where, in the place that', so 'how Israel murmured' is the house reading and 'where' the literal one (?). አንጐርጐሩ is the 3mp perfect of the four-letter verb አንጐርጐረ 'murmur, grumble'. sentences.i: And again the children of Israel murmured about the priesthood before God, saying: 'Are we not Israel? We are the seed of Abraham. How is it that we do not sacrifice, like them, in the tent of testimony, at the ark of the law of God, holy Zion, with censers and incense and holy things, except Moses and his brother Aaron and their sons? Are we not a people chosen like them? Let us do his will!'
sentences.n: Allusion: Numbers 16:1-3 (the claim that 'all the congregation are holy'). ወካዕበ 'and again'. ደቂቀ is the construct of ደቂቅ 'sons' (ደቂቀ እስራኤል 'children of Israel'); በእንተ 'concerning'; ቅድመ 'before'. እንዘ ይብሉ 'while they say, saying' introduces the speech. -ሰ on ንሕነሰ means 'as for us, indeed'; አኮኑ 'is it not so?' marks a question expecting yes. ወእፎ 'and how (is it that)'; ዘኢንሠውዕ 'that we do not sacrifice' (ዘ- 'that' + ኢ- 'not' + 1pl imperfect of ሠውዐ). ከማሆሙ 'like them' (who 'they' are is only named after the clause, by ዘእንበለ 'except Moses and Aaron and their sons', so 'like them' is 'like the priests', ?). ታቦተ ሕጉ ለእግዚኣብሔር 'the ark of his law, of God' (construct with the owner named after the suffix, as in ch. 1); ጽዮን ቅድስት 'holy Zion' stands in apposition: the Ark itself is Zion (the Zion theology of this book). በ- 'with, by means of' on መዓጥንት, ዕጣን, ቅድሳት; ዘእንበለ 'except, apart from'. እኁሁ 'his brother'. እለ ኀረየነ 'who chose us' is literally 'who he chose us': እለ (plural) with a singular verb and a resumptive 'us', God being the understood subject, so the clause is loose (?). ወንገብር is the 1pl jussive 'and let us do'. The long unit has no ፤ inside, so it is kept whole (45 words).

sentences.i: They went, and the chiefs of Israel made seventy censers with which to burn incense to Zion and praise God. They took incense from their houses, and coal, in the censer, and went and entered the Holy of Holies to offer the incense;
sentences.n: The Kebra Nagast moves the scene into the innermost shrine, where Numbers 16:17-18 has the censers brought to the door of the tent of meeting; the number also differs, seventy here against the 250 men of Numbers 16:2. ወአግበሩ 'and they made' (causative-looking አግበረ is simply 'make' here); ሊቃናተ እስራኤል 'chiefs of Israel' (ሊቅ 'chief', plural ሊቃናት; the -ተ ending looks like an accusative though the chiefs seem to be the subject; 'seventy' may instead number the chiefs, so 'seventy of the chiefs made censers' is possible, ?). ማዕጠንታተ 'censers' (ማዕጠንት; plural also መዓጥንት). በዘ 'with which'; የዐጥኑ 'they might offer incense' (jussive of ዐጠነ), ወይሴብሑ 'and might praise' (ሴብሐ/ሰብሐ). ወፍሕመ 'and coal, ember' (ፍሕም). ቅድስተ ቅዱሳን 'holy of holies' (construct). ከመ ይዕጠኑ 'that they might burn incense'.

sentences.i: And God said: 'Make these censers holy for me, for my tent, and let them be for my sacrifice, for it was made holy by their death.' The censer is Mary; the coal too is Christ, the Son of God; he is divinity; and the scent of the incense, his fragrance, is Christ's, in whose fragrance apostles and prophets and martyrs and ascetics renounced the world and inherited the kingdom of heaven;
sentences.n: Compare Numbers 16:37-38 (the censers hallowed, hammered into a covering for the altar). ቀድስዎን is the 2mp imperative of ቀደሰ 'make holy' + ዎን 'them (f.)'; ሊተ 'for me'; ለእሉ መዓጥንት 'these censers' (ለ- marking the object, doubled by the -ዎን of ቀድስዎን); ለደብተራየ 'for my tent' (ደብተራ). ወይኩን is singular 'let it be' with plural censers, which I render 'let them be'. መሥዋዕት 'sacrifice' (or 'altar'). ተቀደሰ 'was made holy' (tä-stem passive); its subject is not stated (the tent, or the offering, ?), and the quotation of God probably runs into the narrator's exegesis at ማዕጠንትሰ. The allegory is a familiar Christian one (the censer Mary, the coal Christ's divinity, the incense his fragrance) (cf. ch. 96, where the same fire stands for divinity). -ሰ 'indeed', -ኒ 'also, and'. ጼና 'scent'. ዘበ መዐዛሁ 'in whose fragrance' (ዘ- + በ, ?). ሰማዕታት 'martyrs'; ፈላስያን 'pilgrims, hermits, ascetics'; መነኑ 'renounced' (መነነ, the monastic verb); መንግሥተ ሰማያት 'kingdom of the heavens' (constructs).

sentences.i: And the cords of the censers are the ladder that Jacob saw, on which they go up and come down, holding fast to it; and with the smoke of the incense the prayers of the pure go up to the throne of God.
sentences.n: Allusion: Genesis 28:12 (Jacob's ladder), read as the chains of the censer. አሕባል 'cords, ropes' (plural of ሐብል) + ሃ 'its'; ሰዋስው 'ladder'; ዘርእየ 'which saw' (ዘ- + ርእየ). በዘ ቦቱ 'by which, on it' (a resumptive pronoun). የዐርጉ ወይወርዲ 'they go up and they come down' (ይወርዲ spells the 3mp ending with ዲ, perhaps for ይወርዱ, ?); ተእኂዞሙ is the gerund (converb in -ዖ) of ተአኀዘ 'hold fast' with -ሙ as the subject, 'they holding fast', as with ሰሚዖሙ in unit 11 (?). ጢሰ ዕጣን 'smoke of incense' (construct). ዲበ 'upon'. መንበረ 'throne of'. The verb የዐርግ is singular with ጸሎቶሙ ለንጹሓን 'their prayer(s), of the pure ones' (ለ- naming the owner after the suffix). Cf. Psalm 141:2 and Revelation 8:3-4 for incense as prayer.

sentences.i: When the flame burned the sinners, the people who were kinsmen of those who had perished slandered Moses and Aaron (?) and said to them: 'You have destroyed our leaders for us!' And they took stones to stone Moses and Aaron;
sentences.n: Compare Numbers 16:41 (the next day all the congregation murmured: 'You have killed the people of the Lord'). አውዐዮሙ is the causative of ውዕየ 'burn' + 'them' (so 'it burned them'). ኃጥኣን 'sinners'. ሐመይዎሙ is ሐመየ 'slander, murmur against' (the house reading: ሐመይዎ ለሙሴ 'they slandered Moses'; cf. ሐሜት 'slander' in the next units) + 'them', here probably Moses and Aaron, named afterwards (?). አዝማዲሆሙ ለእለ ኀልቁ 'kinsmen of those who perished' (አዝማድ, with ለ- naming the owner after the suffix). ለእለ ኀልቁ 'of those who perished' (ኀልቀ 'come to an end'). ወይቤልዎሙ 'and they said to them' (the 'them' anticipates Moses and Aaron, named with ለ-). አኅለቅምዎሙ 'you destroyed them' (አኅለቀ, 2mp, Moses and Aaron together; the perfect ending is printed -ም where -ክሙ would be expected, ?); ለሊቃውንቲነ is the object, 'our leaders' (ሊቅ, plural ሊቃውንት), ለ- marking it and doubled by the -ዎሙ, not a vocative. ከመ ይውግርዎሙ 'that they might stone them' (ወገረ).

sentences.n: ወተምዕዐ 'and he was angry' (ተምዕዐ) with the cognate object መዓተ 'wrath'. ወአስቆረራ 'and he made her (Israel) shudder' (a derived stem related to ቈረረ 'be cold', ?); I take it from 'be cold'. sentences.i: Moses and Aaron went in with incense and the censer, and wept before God and made atonement for the people, saying: 'Remember, O Lord, Abraham, your beloved, and Isaac, your child, and Israel, your holy one; for we are their seed, the children of your people. Quell your wrath, away from us, and hear us quickly, and do not destroy us, and take the scourge away from your people.'
sentences.n: Compare Numbers 16:46-48 (Aaron runs with the censer between the dead and the living) and the prayer of Exodus 32:13. ወበከዩ 'they wept' (በከየ); ወአስተስረዩ 'and they made atonement' (አስተሰረየ, the causative-reflexive stem of 'forgive'). ተዘከር 'remember' (imperative). እግዚኦ 'O Lord' (vocative). አብርሃምሃ: the ending -ሃ I cannot place; it may be an emphatic or vocative particle (?). ፍቁርከ 'your beloved' (ፍቁር with -ከ); ቊልዔከ 'your child' (ቊልዔ). ዘርኦሙ 'their seed'. አቊርር 'quell, cool' (imperative of አቈረረ, 'make cold'; cf. the verb at ወአስቆረራ above, ?). ስምዐነ 'hear us' (imperative + 'us'); ኢታማስነነ 'do not destroy us' (negative jussive of አማሰነ, ?). ወአእትት 'and remove' (imperative of አእተተ). መቅሠፍተ 'scourge' (መቅሠፍት). The long unit has no ፤ inside, so it is kept whole.

glossary.ወሶበ: ሶበ — and when (ወ- + conjunction) · and Sobo (ወ- + proper name ሶበ, in the list of lands ruled by the Ishmaelites, ወሶበ ወኵርጒ; unidentified) (?)
glossary.ወሶቤሃ: ሶቤሃ — and then, at that time (ወ- + adverb)
glossary.ወቀጸባ: ቀጸበ — and he struck her (ወ- + 3ms perfect, G, q-ṣ-b + -ኣ '3fs her')
glossary.ወበሎሙ: ብህለ — and say to them (ወ- + imperative በል of ብህለ, ይቤ 'say' + -ሙ 'them')
glossary.ወበማዕጠንት: ማዕጠንት — and with the censer (ወ- + በ- + noun)
glossary.ወበቅድሳት: ቅድስት — and with holy things (ወ- + በ- + plural ቅድሳት of ቅድስት 'holy thing, hallowed offering')
glossary.ወበትርከሰ: በትር — and your rod, indeed (ወ- + noun + -ከ '2ms your' + contrastive -ሰ)
glossary.ወበዕጣን: ዕጣን — and with incense (ወ- + በ- + noun)
glossary.ወቦኡ: ቦአ — and they entered (ወ- + 3mp perfect, G, b-w-ʾ)
glossary.ወተመስዉ: ተመሰወ — and they melted, dissolved (?) (ወ- + 3mp perfect of ተመሰወ)
glossary.ወተምዕዐ: ተምዕዐ — and he was angry (ወ- + 3ms perfect, tä-stem)
glossary.ወተኀትመት: ተኀትመ — and she was sealed (ወ- + 3fs perfect, passive of ኀተመ 'seal')
glossary.ወነሥኡ: ነሥአ — and they took (ወ- + 3mp perfect, G, n-ś-ʾ)
glossary.ወነበቦ: ነበበ — and he spoke to him (ወ- + 3ms perfect, G, n-b-b, + -ኦ '3ms him')
glossary.ወንሕነሰ: ንሕነ — and as for us (ወ- + 1cp independent pronoun + contrastive -ሰ)
glossary.ወንገብር: ገብረ — and let us do (ወ- + 1cp jussive, G, g-b-r)
glossary.ወአልቦ: አልቦ — and there is not (ወ- 'and' + negative existential)
glossary.ወአሕባሊሃ: ሐብል — and its cords, ropes (ወ- + plural አሕባል + -ሃ '3fs its')
glossary.ወአምጽኡ: አምጽአ — and they brought (ወ- + 3mp perfect, causative of መጽአ) · and bring! (ወ- + 2mp imperative)
glossary.ወአስቆረራ: አስቆረረ — and he made her shudder (?) (ወ- + 3ms perfect, a derived stem apparently related to ቈረረ 'be cold', + -ኣ '3fs her') (?)
glossary.ወአስተስረዩ: አስተሰረየ — and they made atonement (ወ- + 3mp perfect, causative-reflexive stem of ሰረየ 'forgive')
glossary.ወአን: አንስት — and wom(en) (ወ- + the first half of ወአንስቲያሆሙ, wrongly divided from ስቲያሆሙ) (?)
glossary.ወአእትት: አእተተ — and remove, take away! (ወ- + 2ms imperative)
glossary.ወአግበሩ: አግበረ — and they made (ወ- + 3mp perfect; አግበረ 'make, cause to be done')
glossary.ወኢታማስነነ: አማሰነ — and do not destroy us (ወ- + ኢ- 'not' + 2ms jussive, causative stem, + -ነ '1cp us') (?)
glossary.ወእምቤትክሙሂ: ቤት — and from your house too (ወ- + እም- 'from' + noun + -ክሙ '2mp your' + -ሂ 'also')
glossary.ወእንስሳሆሙ: እንስሳ — and their animals, cattle (ወ- + noun + -ሆሙ '3mp their')
glossary.ወወረሱ: ወረሰ — and they inherited (ወ- + 3mp perfect, G, w-r-s)
glossary.ወውኅጠቶሙ: ውኅጠ — and she swallowed them (ወ- + 3fs perfect, G, w-ḫ-ṭ, + -ሙ '3mp them')
glossary.ወውዕዩ: ውዕየ — and they burned (ወ- + 3mp perfect, G, w-ʿ-y; intransitive)
glossary.ወይሴብሑ: ሰብሐ — and they might praise (ወ- + 3mp subjunctive; the stem is spelled ሴብሐ in the imperfect)
glossary.ወይቤልዎሙ: ብህለ — and they said to them (ወ- 'and' + 3mp perfect ይቤሉ of b-h-l + -ልዎሙ 'to them')
glossary.ወይቤሎ: ብህለ — and he said to him (ወ- 'and' + 3ms perfect ይቤ of b-h-l + -ሎ 'to him')
glossary.ወይኩን: ኮነ — and may it be (ወ- 'and' + 3ms jussive, G, k-w-n)
glossary.ወይወርዲ: ወረደ — and they come down (ወ- + 3mp imperfect, G, w-r-d; ending spelled -ዲ, perhaps for ይወርዱ) (?)
glossary.ወደቂቆሙ: ደቂቅ — and their children (ወ- + noun, plural + -ሙ '3mp their')
glossary.ወደዩ: ወደየ — they put, placed (3mp perfect, G, w-d-y)
glossary.ወጸሐፉ: ጸሐፈ — and write! (ወ- + 2mp imperative; the spelling is also that of the 3mp perfect 'and they wrote') (?)
glossary.ወጼና: ጼና — and scent of, fragrance of (ወ- + noun, construct)
glossary.ወፅአ: ወጽአ — he came out (3ms perfect, G; written ወፅአ)
glossary.ወፈላስያን: ፈላሲ — and ascetics, hermits (ወ- + plural ፈላስያን; ፈላሲ 'one who goes into exile, wanderer')
glossary.ወፈትሐት: ፈትሐ — and she opened (ወ- + 3fs perfect, G, f-t-ḥ)
glossary.ወፍሕምኒ: ፍሕም — and the coal too (ወ- + noun + -ኒ 'also')
glossary.ወፍጡነ: ፍጡን — and quickly (ወ- + adjective as adverb, accusative)
glossary.ውሉደ: ወልድ — sons, children (plural ውሉድ, accusative) · construct 'sons of' (ምሕረተ ውሉደ ሰብእ 'the mercy toward the sons of men', ch. 95)
glossary.ውስተ: ውስተ — in, within, into · to, among (ወለአከ ውስተ ኵሉ ነጋድያን 'and he sent to all the merchants') · at (ውስተ መድረከ ኆኃቲሃ 'at the threshold of her doors') · upon, on (ውስተ ሐቌያቲሆሙ 'upon their hips'; ውስተ መንበረ አቡሁ 'on his father's throne')
glossary.ውእቱ: ውእቱ — he, it (3ms independent pronoun; also serves as copula 'is') · 'that' (demonstrative before a noun: ውእቱ ቃለ እግዚኣብሔር 'that word of God')
glossary.ውዕዩ: ውዕየ — they burned (3mp perfect, G, w-ʿ-y; intransitive)
glossary.ውዝዋዜ: ውዝዋዜ — swinging, waving, brandishing (?) (verbal noun; in construct with ማዕጠንት)
glossary.ዕጣን: ዕጣን — incense (noun; here genitive after a construct)
glossary.ዘርአ: ዘርእ — seed (construct 'seed of') · also 'seed' as sown grain, absolute (ዘርአ ወማእረረ 'seed(time) and harvest') · accusative 'offspring' (ይሁበኒ እግዚኣብሔር ዘርአ 'may God give me offspring') · in apposition to ውሉድ: 'offspring' (አልቦውሉደ ዘርአ 'no child, no seed')
glossary.ዘርእየ: ርእየ — what he saw (ዘ- 'what' + 3ms perfect, G) · who saw (ዘ- 'who' relative + 3ms perfect: ዘርእየ ምንዳቤየ 'who saw my distress') · 'which' (ዘ- + 3ms perfect with a following subject: ሰዋስው ዘርእየ ያዕቆብ 'the ladder which Jacob saw')
glossary.ዘርኦሙ: ዘርእ — their seed (noun + -ሙ '3mp their'; anticipating ለአበዊነ) · 'their seed' as predicate with the nominative ንሕነ, '(we are) their seed' (the -ሙ refers to Abraham, Isaac and Israel; no ለአበዊነ follows in this part)
glossary.ዘበ: በ — in, on (preposition; ዘ- 'that which (is)'; spaced off its noun in the edition) · ዘ- 'whose, in which' + በ 'in' before a resumptive suffix (ዘበ መዐዛሁ 'in whose fragrance'; spaced off its noun in the edition) (?)
glossary.ዘተርፈ: ተረፈ — who remained (ዘ- + 3ms perfect, G, t-r-f)
glossary.ዘኢንሠውዕ: ሠውዐ — that we do not sacrifice (ዘ- 'that' + ኢ- 'not' + 1cp imperfect, G, ś-w-ʿ)
glossary.ዘእንበለ: ዘእንበለ — without, except (preposition) · conjunction 'without' + jussive (ዘእንበለ ይስቅይዋ 'without their watering her') · conjunction + perfect 'without (its having been done)' (ዘእንበለ ተሀበኒ ትእምርተ 'without a sign having been given me') · 'except' (ዘእንበለ ዘተሐምም 'except what she suffered') · conjunction 'before' + subjunctive (ዘእንበለ ይስአሉ አበዊነ ንጉሠ 'before our fathers asked for a king') (?)
glossary.ዘዚአሆሙ: ዚአ — that which is theirs (ዘ- + possessive ዚአ + -ሆሙ '3mp')
glossary.ዘፈቀድክሙ: ፈቀደ — what you wished (ዘ- 'what' + 2mp perfect, G, f-q-d)
glossary.ዛቲሰ: ዛቲ — this one, indeed (fem. demonstrative, m. ዝንቱ, + contrastive -ሰ)
glossary.ዜ: ይእዜ — now (the second half of ይእዜ, printed divided from ይእ)
glossary.የውሃቶ: የውሃት — meekness, gentleness (?) (abstract noun from የዋህ 'meek' + -ኦ '3ms his') (?)
glossary.የዐርጉ: ዐርገ — they go up (3mp imperfect, G, ʿ-r-g)
glossary.የዐርግ: ዐርገ — he goes up (3ms imperfect, G, ʿ-r-g)
glossary.የዐጥኑ: ዐጠነ — they might burn incense (3mp subjunctive, G, ʿ-ṭ-n)
glossary.ይረክቦ: ረከበ — finds, meets, reaches (3ms imperfect, G, r-k-b + -ኦ '3ms him, it'; after ሶበ 'when'; whether the flame or the grass is the subject is open) (?)
glossary.ይቤሎሙ: ብህለ — he said to them (3ms perfect ይቤ of b-h-l + -ሎሙ 'to them')
glossary.ይብሉ: ብህለ — they say (3mp subjunctive/imperfect, after እንዘ 'saying') · 'let them say, let them call' (3mp jussive, ሎሙሰ ይብሉ አማልክቲሆሙ 'as for them, let them call them their gods')
glossary.ይብሉከ: ብህለ — they will say to you (3mp imperfect + -ከ '2ms to you')
glossary.ይእ: ይእዜ — now (the first half of ይእዜ, printed divided from ዜ)
glossary.ይእቲ: ይእቲ — she/it is (fem. pron.) · 'I am she' predicate (አነ ይእቲ አቡከ 'I am she, your father') · 'that' (fem. demonstrative, ይእቲ ሠሉስ ዕለት 'that third day') · 'she' restating the subject, a resumptive pronoun before a noun (ይእቲ ባሕርይ 'she, the pearl')
glossary.ይውግርዎሙ: ወገረ — they might stone them (3mp subjunctive, G, w-g-r + -ዎሙ '3mp them')
glossary.ይዕጠኑ: ዐጠነ — they may burn incense (3mp subjunctive, G, ʿ-ṭ-n; after ከመ 'in order to')
glossary.ይጽሐፍ: ጸሐፈ — let him write (3ms jussive, G, ṣ-ḥ-f)
glossary.ደቂቀ: ደቂቅ — sons, children (plural ደቂቅ, construct 'sons of')
glossary.ገባሪተ: ገባሪ — worker of, doer of (agent noun, fem. ገባሪት, construct 'worker of')
glossary.ጸሐፍከ: ጸሐፈ — you wrote (2ms perfect, G, ṣ-ḥ-f, ending -ከ)
glossary.ፀርቀ: ፀርቅ — outburst, stroke (?) (noun, construct or accusative; the word and its meaning are guessed) (?)
glossary.ፈነወ: ፈነወ — he sent (3ms perfect, G, f-n-w)
glossary.ፍቁርከ: ፍቁር — your beloved (passive participle as noun + -ከ '2ms your')
glossary.ፍጽምት: ፍጹም — perfect, complete (adjective, fem. sg. ፍጽምት)
glossary.፺፯: ፺፯ — 97, spoken ተስዓ ወሰብዐቱ (täsʿa wä-säbʿatu) 'ninety-seven'; chapter number (numeral)
